conditions: User must opt-in to location tracking for ad personalization.
effects: Enables or disables location-based ad personalization.

conditions: User has opted in to location-based ad personalization
effects: Location-based ads will be personalized based on user location.

conditions: User has opted out of location-based ad personalization
effects: Location-based ads will not be personalized.

conditions: Privacy configurations must be managed using IAB compatible GPP Consent String and US Privacy Strings.
effects: Sets user privacy preferences, including compliance with COPPA and US Privacy requirements.

conditions: Valid GPP Consent String is provided.
effects: Privacy preferences regarding GPP compliance are set.

conditions: Valid US Privacy String is provided.
effects: Privacy preferences regarding US compliance are set.

conditions: User is under 13 years of age.
effects: Sets the user as subject to COPPA.

conditions: User is over 13 years of age.
effects: Sets the user as not subject to COPPA.

conditions: User opts for 'do not track' preference.
effects: The user is considered opted out of tracking.

conditions: User does not opt for 'do not track' preference.
effects: The user is not opted out of tracking.
